rules: Never eat a plant you cannot name with certainty. A picture that looks right is not enough: check the leaf, stem, flower, fruit and root against the guide, one by one.
Learn the dangerous ones first. The guides under What can hurt you show them.
Edible does not mean edible raw. Acorns must be leached and pokeweed boiled in changes of water before either is safe to eat.
Never eat a mushroom you cannot name with certainty.
The modern guides teach you to recognize a plant. The older books record what people ate and how they prepared it. Use both.
